consequence.statement: Experimental channel API resources (TLSRoute and TCPRoute) are not supported by the Kubernetes Gateway API provider unless experimentalChannel is enabled.

original.statement: In v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer enables experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default; set providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel to true to enable them.

consequence.statement: Unless experimentalChannel is enabled, the Kubernetes Gateway API provider does not support TLSRoute and TCPRoute resources, so routing defined by them is no longer provided after the upgrade to v3.
consequence.remediation: Set providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel: true in the static configuration.

corrected.statement: In v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer supports experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default. Environments relying on them lose that routing unless providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel is set to true.

decision.reason: [ev-5b58f5805519] says that in v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer enables support for the experimental channel resources (TLSRoute and TCPRoute) by default. The migration guide gives a remediation: enable `experimentalChannel`. So these resources are no longer supported. They do not keep working in a different way, which is what behavior-change would mean. For an environment that relies on TLSRoute or TCPRoute, routing stops working unless the operator enables the option, so this is a workload failure and needs action, not just review.
